pt.titulo: OpenAI, Anthropic e Google DeepMind negociam seguranca em IA ha semanas
pt.resumo: Segundo a TechCrunch, OpenAI confirmou semanas de conversas sobre seguranca em IA com Anthropic e Google DeepMind, enquanto a equipe de Trump minimiza as preocupacoes e defende manter o ritmo em relacao a China. A Financial Times disse que funcionarios da OpenAI e da Anthropic se sentiram surpreendidos pelos pedidos de Amodei e Altman para desacelerar a IA.

en.titulo: OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind hold weeks of AI safety talks
en.resumo: According to TechCrunch, OpenAI confirmed weeks of AI safety talks with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, while Trump's team dismisses safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China. The Financial Times reported that OpenAI and Anthropic staff felt blindsided by Dario Amodei's and Sam Altman's calls to slow the frontier, fearing evaluators could compromise security.

fontes.titulo: Reimagining advertising with AI
OpenAI is testing Sponsored Agents, which let users chat with business-sponsored agents and visit advertiser websites via ChatGPT ads, with some US advertisers (Anzar Mehraj/Reuters)

pt.titulo: OpenAI testa Sponsored Agents em anuncios do ChatGPT
pt.resumo: Segundo a Reuters, a OpenAI testa os Sponsored Agents, que permitem aos usuarios conversar com agentes patrocinados por empresas e visitar sites de anunciantes via anuncios no ChatGPT, com alguns anunciantes dos Estados Unidos. A OpenAI descreveu a novidade como parte de uma reimaginacao da publicidade com IA, com integracoes com HubSpot e Shopify.

en.titulo: OpenAI tests sponsored agents in ChatGPT ads
en.resumo: According to Reuters, OpenAI is testing Sponsored Agents, which let users chat with business-sponsored agents and visit advertiser websites via ChatGPT ads, with some US advertisers. OpenAI described the feature as part of reimagining advertising with AI, including integrations with HubSpot and Shopify.

en.titulo: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
en.resumo: According to Google, Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking are its most advanced live dialogue models yet, built for natural conversation. The company also released Gemini 3.5 Transcribe for real-time voice applications, according to Google.
